latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of the "Agent 上下文管理方法论 (context-management)" skill.
- Introduces a layered file system to enable memory persistence, context recovery, and role separation across agent sessions.
- Defines five core layers: SOUL.md (identity), USER.md (user info), AGENTS.md (routing/workflow), TOOLS.md (environment), and memory/MEMORY.md (short/long-term memory).
- Provides guidelines for regular memory distillation, cleanup routines, and heartbeat-based maintenance.
- Includes an automated script (memory_distill.py) for extracting and refining technical learnings from daily memory files.
- Outlines best practices, quick start instructions, and usage scenarios for robust context management in agents.
